verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a SaaS control plane with an API (API keys are mentioned), so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question here. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any standard candidate path, and no docs item mentions one. The llms.txt file is a documentation index for LLMs, not an API spec, so it earns no credit.
